messages:
samantha: customer demo just hit a ~30s stall during a paginated import. pages 4-6 show no requests leaving the client for a long stretch then a burst of 429s.
ryan: which SDK + version?
samantha: java-sdk v1.4.0, default adaptive limiter enabled. sample-app used `--page-size 200 --concurrency 8`.
samantha: logs: ```
[2027-12-10T09:12:01Z] INFO page=3 enqueued=8 limiter=tok/sec=100
[2027-12-10T09:12:02Z] WARN limiter queue depth=120 waiting
[2027-12-10T09:12:31Z] INFO page=4 flush 0 reqs -> 30s stall
[2027-12-10T09:12:31Z] ERROR burst send -> 429 x24
```
prashant: hmm, java limiter does a refill calc that floors to int which can undercount tokens when window intervals are tiny. code: ```java
long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
int refill = (int)((now - lastRefillMs) * tokensPerSecond / 1000);
available += refill;
```
prashant: when multiple page streams share the same limiter key (we were using userId+model), tiny time diffs can make refill=0 repeatedly and queue piles up then drain in a huge burst.
ryan: JS and Go SDKs include the cursor in limiter/batcher key for paginated flows which prevents cross-page merging. Java missed that parity change.
qa-tom: I can add an integration test that spins two goroutines (simulated pages) hitting the same session and asserts limiter fairness. also add an e2e flag for sample-app `--separate-pagination-batches`.
eng-ops: for live mitigation we pushed a client-config override to affected orgs: set adaptive.tokensPerSecond=25 and adaptive.maxBurst=2 to smooth things. that reduced 429s on the demo.
samantha: thanks, mitigation helped for the call. customer asked for timeline for patch.
prashant: immediate plan: 1) include pagination cursor in limiter key when Pagination.enabled == true 2) switch refill calc to use double arithmetic and cap min-refill=1 if queue > threshold 3) add small jitter to retry backoff and ensure token refresh singleflight. will PR tonight.
prashant: patch snippet: ```java
List<String> keyParts = List.of(opts.userId, opts.model);
if (opts.pagination != null && opts.pagination.cursor != null) keyParts.add("cur:"+opts.pagination.cursor);
String limiterKey = String.join("|", keyParts);
// refill fix
double refillD = (now - lastRefillMs) * tokensPerSecond / 1000.0;
int refill = (int)Math.max(1, Math.floor(refillD));
available = Math.min(capacity, available + refill);
```
qa-tom: will author tests for concurrency and add CI e2e for sample-app with `--page-streams 3`.
